run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T19:30:16Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend-proxy coincides with a short 5xx burst. Within the sampled window 18:30:16Z-19:46:47Z the only frontend-proxy error burst is in the [5m] windows ending 19:22:16Z through 19:26:16Z (0 before, 0 again at 19:27:16Z), and frontend-proxy access logs show "POST /api/checkout" returning 500 via_upstream between 19:21:35Z and 19:22:09Z while other routes returned 200. The same burst appears one level down: checkout's only errored spans are oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and its client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, and payment itself has no ERROR-status spans. In those minutes (19:20:38Z-19:20:41Z) Deployment otel-demo/payment replaced its single replica with a new ReplicaSet payment-54499f9786 whose pod template carries kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T19:20:38Z with the same image and env as the old ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9, and the new payment process logged "payment gRPC server started on port 8080" only at 19:21:56Z. Separately, ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config holds a switched-on fault setting paymentUnreachable (defaultVariant "on", description "Payment service is unavailable") naming exactly the service that was restarted with an unchanged template and whose callers errored; its change time could not be established and payment charges succeeded again from 19:22:29Z with the setting still on, so it is named as the root cause only on a partial basis with both points recorded as gaps.

claims.text: For service_name="frontend-proxy", the [5m] increase of STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans was 0 up to the window ending 19:21:16Z, then 32.2 (ending 19:22:16Z), 76.7 (19:23:16Z), 78.2-79.3 (19:24:16Z), 77.8 (19:25:16Z), 45.6 (19:26:16Z) and 0 again at 19:27:16Z, on span_name "router frontend egress" and "ingress" alike; these are span counts of a sampled view, not unique request counts.

Over the 70 minutes to 19:45:16Z, frontend-proxy span_name="ingress" shows 89.2 STATUS_CODE_ERROR span increases against 26232.5 STATUS_CODE_UNSET (UNSET means the span carried no status, not success), i.e. a small error share concentrated in the 19:21-19:26Z burst.

Error-span totals over the 76-minute query window by service: frontend 279.8, frontend-proxy 159.2, checkout 84.9, recommendation 4.05, ad 3.05, fraud-detection 3.05, accounting 0, payment 0 — payment records no ERROR-status spans while its callers do.

checkout's errored spans are only oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (server) and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (client): both are 0 before the window ending 19:22:16Z, rise to 53.8/51.3/47.0/45.6 in the windows ending 19:23:16Z-19:26:16Z, and return to 0 from the window ending 19:27:16Z; the frontend's errored spans (POST /api/checkout, executing api route /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder) follow the same pattern.

frontend-proxy access log lines show "POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream ... frontend ... with a 21-byte response body between 19:21:35.502Z and 19:22:09.317Z, while GET /api/products returned 200 in the same seconds.

Events in namespace otel-demo record Deployment payment ScalingReplicaSet up of payment-54499f9786 at 19:20:38Z, ReplicaSet payment-54499f9786 SuccessfulCreate at 19:20:38Z, Pod payment-54499f9786-4r25d Scheduled/Pulled/Created 19:20:38-19:20:40Z and Started 19:20:41Z, then Pod payment-55766d76b9-846r8 Killing at 19:20:41Z and Deployment payment ScalingReplicaSet down of payment-55766d76b9 from 1 to 0 at 19:20:41Z.

The new ReplicaSet payment-54499f9786 (created 19:20:38Z, replicas 1) carries pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T19:20:38Z; the old ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9 (created 18:48:26Z, replicas 0) has no restartedAt annotation; both templates use image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment with identical env (PAYMENT_PORT, FLAGD_HOST, FLAGD_PORT, OTEL_*), i.e. a configuration-only restart of the same image.

Deployment otel-demo/payment is 1 replica with strategy RollingUpdate (maxSurge 25%, maxUnavailable 25%) and its container "payment" has readinessProbe null and livenessProbe null (only port 8080/TCP, limits cpu 20m / memory 160Mi).

The new payment container payment-54499f9786-4r25d logged "payment gRPC server started on port 8080" at 2026-11-17T19:21:56.571Z and its first "Charge request received." at 19:22:29.971Z; between 19:20:30Z and 19:21:56Z that container produced no log lines at all (only 2 lines existed in the 19:20:30-19:22:30Z window).

From 19:22:29Z onwards payment logged repeated "Charge request received." / "Transaction complete." pairs (sampled 19:27:10-19:27:59Z and again 19:33:35-19:34:35Z), i.e. charge calls were succeeding again after the burst.

ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config (key demo.flagd.json) defines flag paymentUnreachable with description "Payment service is unavailable", state ENABLED, variants {"off": false, "on": true} and defaultVariant "on" — a switched-on fault-injection setting whose description names the payment service.

All other fault-injection flags in the same ConfigMap are defaultVariant "off": adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure (variants 10%-90%/off), productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure, and emailMemoryLeak (variants 1x-10000x/off).
At 19:46:50Z all 21 otel-demo pods were Running and Ready with restartCount 0, including frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-sznks (startTime 18:48:26Z) and payment-54499f9786-4r25d (startTime 19:20:38Z).
The payment Service endpoint object has a single subset addressing pod payment-54499f9786-4r25d at 100.96.5.201, port 8080/tcp-service, so the new pod is the only backend of the payment Service.

frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-sznks kept serving normally through the burst: its access log shows 200 responses for /, /api/products/*, /api/cart and /api/data at 19:22:55-19:22:59Z, and the pod has restartCount 0.

The burst is explained by the 19:20:38Z rollout restart of the single-replica payment Deployment: with no readiness probe, the new container was treated as Ready when it Started at 19:20:41Z and the old replica was killed the same second, while the new payment process only began listening at 19:21:56Z; in that gap checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge calls failed and frontend returned 500 on /api/checkout, which frontend-proxy logged as 5xx ingress errors.

The switched-on setting paymentUnreachable ("Payment service is unavailable") in ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config is the injected fault behind the payment-unavailable behaviour: it names the payment service, payment was restarted with an unchanged image at 19:20:38Z, and its callers' Charge spans errored in the following minutes; this remains a hypothesis because the flag's change time and enforcement path could not be observed.

Against the flag being the active cause of the burst: payment served charges again from 19:22:29Z (repeated "Charge request received."/"Transaction complete.") while paymentUnreachable still reads "on", and checkout/frontend/frontend-proxy error spans are zero from the window ending 19:27:16Z onward, so the declared fault effect was not observable after the pod replacement completed.

Add a readinessProbe (and a livenessProbe) on the payment container's 8080 port, or run more than one payment replica, so a rolling update or rollout restart cannot remove the only serving replica before the gRPC server is listening.

Confirm whether paymentUnreachable in otel-demo/flagd-config is intended to be "on"; if it is a leftover test fault, switch it off and re-validate charge traffic, since charges currently succeed with the setting on and its effect cannot be ruled in or out from this run.

gaps: The alert rule could not be read: the list_prometheus_rules query for rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned no data (a9c25268-499c-4793-9e02-a0a5b4baa6b5-t0:d9fd424d-fb8a-41e0-82d2-807ec614d7b0), so the rule expression, threshold and lookback behind the reported value 0.02222222222222222 are unknown, and that value could not be reproduced from the visible frontend-proxy span series (70-minute ingress ERROR span share ~0.34%).

When the paymentUnreachable flag was switched to "on" could not be established: the flagd container in flagd-678dcfdc67-bl78w returned no log lines for 18:45-19:35Z (4afda942-e165-416b-b398-f880571c926d-t1:2c76690a-0d3a-4424-be72-b44b3126ab84), no ConfigMap change timestamp is observable, and the change_history integration is not available in this Run.
Who or what issued the rollout restart recorded as kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T19:20:38Z on the payment pod template is unknown; no change record is available in this Run.
Whether paymentUnreachable actually enforces charge failures could not be verified: payment processed charges from 19:22:29Z with the flag reported "on".

No kube_* state series and no http_*/rpc_*/app_* series were returned by metrics discovery/range queries against this Prometheus (kube_replicaset_owner, kube_pod/container series, http_server_request_duration_seconds_count all empty: 4afda942-e165-416b-b398-f880571c926d-t2:54a83f0f-2593-47cc-bd48-1a17094972d5, e30ffc3b-3d22-46ef-8ecf-4ea7c58325a2-t2:c5669ce9-34b4-43e4-be3e-44d59a15b905, 70e969ab-6d45-410f-a373-c66607ed89fc-t0:5759ec8b-91d1-4138-847d-aa78ab707f21, a337ab27-71f6-48a1-ab53-9d7943abe56d-t1:03fe96ef-b910-438b-8377-93986c12f2ec); absence here is unknown, not zero.

Jaeger returned no traces for frontend in 19:20:00-19:28:00Z (70e969ab-6d45-410f-a373-c66607ed89fc-t1:c7d24e9e-f7c0-49e2-9587-1436d34f51a3) and none for checkout with error=true in 19:15-19:30Z (83a7061f-ec0b-40bf-93c3-fd962bed919a-t2:20c2eda9-cf78-437b-92cd-b407f0d20aef), so the exact error message of the failed Charge calls is unknown.
The replaced pod payment-55766d76b9-846r8 was deleted at 19:20:41Z; its logs and previous-instance logs are unavailable, so its last state could not be checked.

The queried frontend container returned no log lines for 19:20-19:28Z (3e92be8c-39b0-4783-adbe-c0681659236a-t2:a7783de2-daf4-4111-aaea-1037de0216a7), so frontend's own error text at the time of the 500s was not read.

The NetworkPolicy query for otel-demo returned nothing (35f8981f-782d-4ed4-8bac-e3d1288052f7-t2:f1442ba4-3542-427d-a788-1ba13c88cbe3); this empty result alone cannot exclude a network-level cause of the failed calls.

Log views used are incomplete by row limit (newest N lines only) for payment, checkout and frontend-proxy: 83a7061f-ec0b-40bf-93c3-fd962bed919a-t1:cc612d91-1c45-4827-bcbd-d01e8a8051a1, 4afda942-e165-416b-b398-f880571c926d-t0:dafa979f-31fb-4ffe-8c77-adcb6014734b, 3e92be8c-39b0-4783-adbe-c0681659236a-t0:51a4f4a4-f357-4032-862d-43b555d52870, 35f8981f-782d-4ed4-8bac-e3d1288052f7-t0:46accb69-b6e9-4033-a5dc-e7aab49663a2, 3bd9680d-e96d-4e8e-ae3e-98063d8dc75d-t0:6cb3a700-0f1c-4296-8b7a-77f1169305de; lines outside the shown ranges are unknown.
next_steps: Review the payment Deployment rollout/restart history and cluster audit log to identify who triggered the 19:20:38Z restartedAt and why.
Check whether RequestErrorRate should use a shorter evaluation window or a non-zero threshold, since a ~75-second payment restart produced 5xx responses and a non-zero error rate.
If paymentUnreachable is meant to stay off, set it off in otel-demo/flagd-config and confirm charge traffic remains successful and that the flag's effect is understood.
